clips.title: The story
paras: In Ashenvale, Ran Bloodtooth's Skull bears proof that a corrupted furbolg chieftain has fallen. The night elves of Astranaar receive it as a sign that a fierce threat to their woodland realm has ended.

The furbolgs of Ashenvale have fallen into murderous madness under demonic taint and wilderness corruption. Ran Bloodtooth led one of the fiercest tribes. His skull gives the night elf Sentinels proof that he has fallen and his hold over the local furbolgs is broken, bringing some respite to Astranaar.
